# RushtoMax

> RushtoMax is a free, browser-based Clash of Clans upgrade planner. Players paste the village JSON exported from the game and get a timed checklist for the fastest way to rush to a higher Town Hall or to max their current Town Hall, with a PDF download. No sign-up is needed and village data never leaves the browser.

## What it does
- Rush: fastest route to a chosen higher Town Hall (up to Town Hall 18), running Town Hall upgrades back to back while other builders, the Laboratory and the Pet House work in parallel.
- Max: fastest route to a fully maxed base at the current Town Hall level; if the account is below the top Town Hall it offers to rush first.
- Storage-aware: checks that Gold, Elixir and Dark Elixir storages can hold each upgrade cost and adds the storage upgrades that are needed.
- Limits: treats times as a lower bound; it does not track current loot, boosts, helpers, walls or hero equipment ore.

## Links
- [RushtoMax planner](https://rushtomax.vercel.app/): the tool, with a how-it-works guide and FAQ
- [Sitemap](https://rushtomax.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
